name: Fly Conecta Internet LTDA
notes: Flyconecta operates as a regional ISP and Transit Provider (Upstream) for multiple downstream ASNs. Our networks core is located 231 km away from the nearest public internet exchange. We maintain an open peering policy for direct PNI but do not participate in public IXPs due to transport backhaul constraints. Total aggregated traffic is within the 50-100 Gbps range. We already host local caching nodes from Google (GGC) and Netflix (OCA). For peering and capacity requests, please contact NOC/Peering.
